trends.name: Iran Conflict & Oil Supply Shock
trends.summary: Escalating US-Iran military tensions are triggering real supply disruptions with Saudi Arabia rerouting 5M bbl/day via Red Sea and Bessent signaling US control of Strait of Hormuz. Trump threatens to 'obliterate' Iranian oil infrastructure if deal not reached, creating severe near-term oil price volatility and extended recession risk in Europe, with German Chancellor warning impact could rival COVID-19 pandemic.

trends.name: Recession Risk Surging to 40%
trends.summary: Prediction markets now price 40% recession probability—a sharp climb from recent weeks—driven by Iran war escalation, rising energy costs, and tightening financial conditions. Consumer spending pressures mounting via higher fuel/transportation costs and underwater auto trade-ins (1 in 3 buyers affected).

trends.name: S&P 500 Correction Bottoming
trends.summary: Morgan Stanley's Mike Wilson signals S&P 500 correction 'getting closer to ending' despite Fed policy uncertainty. Market breadth warnings persist but valuations increasingly attractive; Bill Ackman notes US stocks appear 'extremely cheap' amid volatility, creating buying opportunity narratives alongside correction endgame signals.

trends.name: Mag 7 & AI Chip Resilience
trends.summary: Mega-cap tech stocks (Meta +1%, Nvidia +0.6%, Microsoft +0.9%) gaining premarket despite macro turmoil, signaling institutional rotation into AI winners. Samsung-backed Rebellions raises $400M for IPO as quantum/AI chip sector races to market amid perceived 'inflection point,' offsetting broader market weakness.

trends.name: Intel CPU Comeback Thesis
trends.summary: Multiple analyst calls positioning Intel as 'highest conviction buy' and 'CPU comeback nobody sees,' citing oversold valuation ahead of key product ramps. Counter-narrative to AI-driven Nvidia dominance gaining traction as investors hunt turnaround stories amid market volatility.

trends.name: Defense/Aerospace Ramp Plays
trends.summary: Northrop Grumman flagged as undervalued ahead of key program ramps amid heightened geopolitical tensions and Pentagon preparation for ground assault scenarios. Iran conflict escalation driving defense contractor upside as budget commitments accelerate.

trends.name: Palantir as System-of-Record Winner
trends.summary: Palantir positioned as 'system behind decisions' with integrated platform narrative gaining traction. Company benefits from defense/intelligence spending acceleration and broader enterprise AI adoption trends amid macro uncertainty.

trends.name: 401(k) Alternative Assets Expansion
trends.summary: Department of Labor proposes new rules enabling alternative assets (private equity, real estate, hedge funds) in 401(k) plans, potentially unlocking trillions in retail capital allocation. Significant structural shift for asset management industry and opportunity for alternative investment platforms.

trends.name: Sysco Restaurant Depot Megadeal
trends.summary: Sysco pursuing $29B acquisition of Restaurant Depot to consolidate food service distribution, signaling M&A activity resuming amid market volatility. Deal reflects sector consolidation trends and post-inflationary operational optimization.

trends.name: European Energy Crisis & CPI Spike
trends.summary: German CPI jumped to 2.7% YoY (from 1.9%) with EU Harmonized at 2.8%, driven by Iran war energy shocks. German Economy Minister planning relief measures post-Easter; Chancellor Merz warning expansion could rival COVID-19 impact—indicating persistent stagflation risk for eurozone.

trends.name: Dollar Strength & Yen Weakness
trends.summary: US Dollar continues advancing despite geopolitical turmoil, while verbal Iran conflict threats ironically lifting Yen as safe-haven demand proves temporary. Currency dynamics reflecting divergent policy outlooks and capital flows amid recession fears.

trends.name: Mortgage Rates Rising Pre-Election
trends.summary: 30-year fixed mortgage rates climbing back above 6% due to Iran war-driven long-term rate pressure 8 months before midterms, reversing administration's early affordability wins. Housing market headwind from geopolitical escalation with political cycle implications.
